profile.intro: I am a Computer Science and Networks engineering student at ENSISA (University of Haute-Alsace), with graduation expected in 2027. I am currently completing an academic exchange at Kyoto Institute of Technology in Japan, from September 2026 to March 2027.
profile.values: My internships, apprenticeship and projects have given me experience with real applications, from understanding requirements to deployment. I am particularly interested in backend development, business applications, APIs and databases. I am looking for a six-month final-year internship starting in April 2027.
profile.passions: Outside software development, I play badminton and enjoy motorsport, video games, LEGO and travelling.
